subject.title: feat: Add Anthropic server-side compaction API support

question: Should Anthropic-native compaction use provider-specific model/run parameters, or become a mode under agents.defaults.compaction, and should pause_after_compaction participate in the OpenClaw agent loop?
rationale: These choices define a compatibility-sensitive public configuration contract and terminal-turn behavior; source inspection cannot establish maintainer intent safely.

options.title: Provider parameters
options.body: Expose Anthropic-specific enablement, threshold, instructions, and pause behavior through model/run params, following the existing provider-owned and OpenAI server-compaction pattern.

options.title: Shared compaction mode
options.body: Add an Anthropic mode beneath agents.defaults.compaction and translate shared compaction settings into provider request behavior.

options.title: Defer beta support
options.body: Retain OpenClaw-local compaction until Anthropic's compaction contract leaves beta or a broader context-management design is approved.

recommendation.title: Provider parameters
recommendation.body: Expose Anthropic-specific enablement, threshold, instructions, and pause behavior through model/run params, following the existing provider-owned and OpenAI server-compaction pattern.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history and discussion signals connect this person to both the shared compaction configuration and Anthropic provider transport surfaces involved in the decision.
